steps.title: Clean Build Script Dependencies
steps.description: Remove non-standard third-party dependencies from build.gradle to ensure 100% native Android SDK compliance.

steps.title: Fix Board Grid Type in LCD View
steps.description: Correct board matrix type from byte[][] to int[][] in LcdScreenView to resolve compilation failure with BrickGameEngine.getBoard().

steps.title: Verify Color Resources
steps.description: Confirm text_shell_label, shell_screen_frame, and arcade palette colors are defined.

steps.title: Verify 3D Vector Math Pipeline
steps.description: Validate 3D vector transformations, pitch and yaw rotations, and dot product calculations.

steps.title: Verify Polygon Depth Sorter
steps.description: Ensure Painter's depth sorting correctly arranges polygons from furthest to nearest.

steps.title: Verify Tetromino Topologies
steps.description: Check classic 7 tetromino rotational matrices and neon color definitions.

steps.title: Verify Core Game Engine
steps.description: Validate collision detection, line clear scoring, gravity loop, and drop mechanics.

steps.title: Verify 3D Viewport Rendering
steps.description: Confirm 3D glass cage rendering, directional Lambertian lighting, and touch orbital camera.

steps.title: Verify Retro Tone Audio
steps.description: Confirm safe 8-bit ToneGenerator synthesis for piece movement, rotation, and line clears.

steps.title: Building Brick Game Classic
steps.description: Compile debug and release APK using Gradle build tools.
